definitions.explanation: The essential meaning or most important points of a text, speech, or argument.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}の{要旨|ようし}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write a summary of the thesis.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{要旨|ようし}をまとめた。
examples.english: I summarized the gist of the meeting.

examples.japanese: {発言|はつげん}の{要旨|ようし}は{以下|いか}の{通|とお}りです。
examples.english: The summary of the statement is as follows.

examples.japanese: {記事|きじ}の{要旨|ようし}を{三行|さんぎょう}でまとめてください。
examples.english: Please summarize the gist of the article in three lines.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{要旨|ようし}だけ{読|よ}めば、{全体|ぜんたい}の{内容|ないよう}がだいたい{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: If you just read the summary of the report, you can get a general idea of the overall content.

notes:
USAGE: {要旨|ようし} is commonly used in academic and formal contexts for summaries.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{要旨|ようし}をまとめる (to summarize the main points)
・{要旨|ようし}を{説明|せつめい}する (to explain the gist)
・{論文|ろんぶん}の{要旨|ようし} (thesis abstract)

RELATED:
・{概要|がいよう} - outline, summary (more general)
・{要約|ようやく} - summary, abstract
・{要点|ようてん} - main point, key point
